main.description: Lists indexed funding receipts matching the supplied filters: filters combine with AND, while values within an array combine with OR. Repeat array parameters to supply multiple values; duplicates are ignored. Authentication is not required.

authors.description: Publisher repository DIDs, including facilitator, personal, and group repositories.

uris.description: Funding-receipt AT-URIs with a DID authority, matched by URI only, not CID.

from.description: Sender DIDs or full record AT-URIs with a DID authority. DIDs match only the DID variant; AT-URIs match only the strong-reference URI, not CID. Resolve handles to DIDs; invalid entries reject the request with the parameter and entry identified.

to.description: Recipient DIDs or full record AT-URIs with a DID authority. DIDs match only the DID variant; AT-URIs match only the strong-reference URI, not CID. Resolve handles to DIDs; invalid entries reject the request with the parameter and entry identified.

forUris.description: Funded-target AT-URIs with a DID authority, matched by URI only; CID is not compared.

transactionIds.description: Exact transaction ID matches; values are not normalized.

sortDirection.description: Direction for ordering by createdAt then URI; defaults to desc.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to sortDirection; keep all other parameters unchanged between pages.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A filter or pagination parameter is invalid.

errors.name: ReceiptQueryFailed
errors.description: The receipt query or publisher hydration failed.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted when there is no next page.
